ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $BC=4\,\text{cm}$, $BD=7\,\text{cm}$, and point $D$ is the midpoint of $AC$. What is the length of $AC$ in centimeters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $CD = BD - BC = 7 - 4 = 3\,(\text{cm})$\\
Since point D is the midpoint of AC, it follows that $AC = 2CD = \boxed{6}\,(\text{cm})$
